Read on for all the details.

Amazon now has Apple's most affordable 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $300 off, with more deals on the way

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deal, we've already covered quite a few July Black Friday MacBook Pro offers, some of the most noteworthy of which are from Amazon and B&H. You'll see highlighted configurations below, but we especially wanted to spotlight the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model, now $300 off at Amazon.

Amazon currently has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB of built-in storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

We noted this is the most affordable 2TB configuration among the 15-core CPU/16-core GPU internal specs — the upgraded 18-core variant is $2,960, or $239 off, just for reference.

This configuration was priced close to $3,000, and now Amazon has it at $300 off — the best deal we've tracked since the recent price increase.

Indeed, this machine did sell for less before, but those days are gone. If you're looking to upgrade in 2026, $300 off is solid no matter how you look at it.

Grab July Black Friday Apple Watch Series 11 deals from $299 ($100 off) while supplies last

There's still plenty of summer left, and if you're looking to pick up a new Apple wearable, now's the time to act while the most popular Series 11 models are $100 off.

Over the past week or so, we've spotted some particularly strong deals on higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, but if you're after the most affordable — and honestly, in my opinion, the best value — model in the lineup, the $100 off base model is the way to go:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As of this morning/at time of writing, the base aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models on Amazon are still at $100 off. However, we're starting to see some case colors for the larger 46mm model go out of stock, so you may want to do your homework before prices tick back up.

These deals are roughly in line with the best prices we've tracked since launch, except for some models being about $20 cheaper during June Prime Day. But with July Black Friday deals likely wrapping up this weekend, we're probably going to see these Apple Watch Series 11 deals end shortly after — in fact, we're already starting to see that happen.

Heads up! Satechi's 25W Space Black Metal 3-in-1 MagSafe stand is among the best, now down to an all-time low of $78 (40% off)

Alright, enough talk — my personal favorite new 25W Qi2 MagSafe charging stand has once again dropped to its lowest price ever. The Satechi Space Black Metal 3-in-1 Qi2 Wireless Charging Station is now down to $77.99 with free shipping at Amazon.

Satechi's official Amazon storefront is currently being especially aggressive on pricing for its latest 2026 Qi2 25W MagSafe charging station, dropping it to $77.99 with free shipping.

This premium charging setup, originally $130, is now marked down a full 40%.

We previously saw this model first drop to a new low of $104 during Prime Day, then fall again to $91 earlier, and now Amazon has cut it once more — making it, in my view, one of the best value 25W MagSafe charging stands on the market.

There are indeed cheaper 25W charging stands out there, but when it comes to the balance of quality and price, nothing beats this price point as far as I've seen.

What you're looking at here is a full Space Black metal exterior with clean lines — one of the sleekest, most attractive desktop charging solutions on the market. Of course, the main 25W MagSafe charging pad on the top articulating arm offers an ideal viewing angle, there's an excellent pop-out Apple Watch charger on the back, and a Qi pad on the base for charging your AirPods.

You can check out our launch coverage for more details, but in short, you're getting one of the top-tier options on the market at the best price right now.

Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2 July Black Friday $100 off (all colors)

In addition to the ongoing $50 off AirPods Pro 3 deal and the new AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low price, one of the most attractive July Black Friday offers is $100 off the 2026 AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now offering Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 down to $449 with free shipping — a straight $100 off the $549 original price, the best deal around right now.

This offer applies to all five colors: Midnight, Blue, Purple, Starlight, and Orange.

This is the lowest price we've tracked for the new generation of Apple over-ear headphones, except for the brief Prime Day price earlier (when most colors had sold out before the event ended). Today's deal is the second time we've seen more than $50 off since launch earlier this year.

With the summer shopping season typically peaking during the July Prime Day event, and this year's event having moved up a month, this July Black Friday 2026 price is likely to be the best Max 2 deal we track before fall. If you're looking to grab one over the summer or even later, the $100 off is probably the best price you'll see before the Black Friday discount season (or more likely, the early October Black Friday deals that have been starting earlier and earlier in recent years).

They look the same as the previous generation AirPods Max (USB-C), but there are significant internal upgrades, starting with the H2 chip.
